eu.note: There is no EDGAR equivalent in Europe: filed ranges live in prospectuses and ITF releases, not in a machine-readable filing index. This panel is therefore assembled deal by deal. A monthly scheduled task appends newly priced European IPOs with a source link for each row; anything with verified=false has not yet been checked against a primary document and is excluded from the headline statistics.
